objective: Make Current-to-Survivor opportunity continuity airtight for both Pump and Pons and add durable marginal-reject/opportunity-loss instrumentation without changing admission thresholds, exits, capital, or trading authority.

pons.canonical_asset_identity: token address + verified Pons graduation/Uniswap V4 market lineage

marginal_reject_instrumentation.coverage: all Pump Current and Pons Current evaluated rejections; marginality is an analytic label only and never grants entry authority
classification: Record exact signed distance for every measurable gate, not only the first failure.
A marginal-reject label requires all applicable hard-safety/evidence/execution categories to pass.
Rank failed alpha gates by normalized distance from threshold; do not alter qualification.
Multiple alpha failures remain visible and must not be collapsed into a single reason.
runtime_constraints: The decision-time reject receipt must be bounded and durable.
Outcome enrichment must use persisted/canonical evidence and must not add provider calls to the Current decision critical path.
Instrumentation has zero order, reservation, sizing, or qualification authority.
Instrumentation failure must be observable and auditable; it must not silently mutate strategy decisions.

required_proofs: Pump Current reject -> verified migration -> Pump Survivor candidate remains discoverable and independently evaluable.
Pons Current reject -> verified graduation -> Pons Survivor candidate remains discoverable and independently evaluable.
Restart between Current rejection and Survivor enrollment preserves the linkage and does not lose Survivor eligibility.
A Current hard-safety rejection does not become a permanent Survivor rejection unless the Survivor policy independently rejects the fresh evidence or owns an immutable lineage/integrity failure.
An open/reserved Current position may coexist with Survivor observation but shared-sleeve fencing prevents duplicate family exposure.
Marginal-reject receipts preserve all gate distances and later MFE/MAE windows without changing Current or Survivor decisions.
No new provider request is introduced solely to create reject instrumentation on the Current critical path.
Existing PAPER-only, generation, freshness, capacity, concentration, creator/distribution and accounting safeguards remain unchanged.
promotion_requirements: Do not compose into the active Stage E/F/G exact-candidate lineage.
After Stage E/F/G machinery is complete, implement this requirement against the exact final machinery SHA rather than patching the active certification candidate.
Regenerate affected policy/runtime identities only where implementation bytes require it; do not change strategy thresholds as part of this work.
Run deterministic Pump and Pons Current-to-Survivor continuity tests, including restart/replay and shared-sleeve conflict cases.
Run reject-telemetry schema, gate-distance, MFE/MAE, and no-decision-authority tests.
Run provider-call accounting to prove reject capture adds no decision-critical provider work.
Run exact-SHA non-market certification of the fully composed PAPER candidate before any market smoke.
Start a fresh affected-lane profitability cohort if implementation changes economic behavior; pure observation-only telemetry by itself must not be treated as an economic-policy change.
